<b>Dark Hearts</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, acquired from the Wishwall in [[Bellhart]] after completing the objective [[SEEK: Awaiting the End]].

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, Hornet must find and destroy 12 out of 47 [[Void Mass]]es (45 in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]) across [[Pharloom]]. Void Masses destroyed before accepting the quest still count for its progress once accepted.

*1 can be found in [[Bone Bottom]], [[Weavenest Atla]], [[Bilewater]], [[Grand Gate]], and [[Cogwork Core]].
*2 can be found in the [[Hunter's March]] and [[High Halls]].
*3 can be found in the [[Far Fields]], [[Blasted Steps]], [[Underworks]], [[Deep Docks]], [[Sinner's Road]],<ref group="Note">The two near [[Styx]] do not appear in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]].</ref> and [[Whispering Vaults]].
*4 can be found in [[the Marrow]].
*5 can be found in [[Greymoor]] and [[Shellwood]].
*6 can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]].

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Void Mass 01.png!Locations across Pharloom
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Mask Shard (Silksong).png|link=Mask Shard (Silksong)|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After slaying 12 Void Masses, simply interacting with Bellhart's Wishwall allows Hornet to receive a [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]].
